posts.description: Claude confinement I don't trust Claude Code, and especially myself, to not inadvertently upload any or all of my private data to Anthropic's servers and thus be immortalized in logs. That's why Claude lives in a dedicated lxc container on my machine. If need be, I can mount shared volumes, or forward ports to/from the host, but I find that's rarely necessary.
